        "originalContents": "\n\n  static subscribeToOutgoingFollowRequests(userId: string, callback: (requests: FollowRequest[]) =\u003e void) {\n    try {\n      console.log('[SocialService] Setting up outgoing follow requests listener for user:', userId);\n      const requestsQuery = query(\n        collection(db, 'followRequests'),\n        where('fromUserId', '==', userId)\n        // Temporarily remove orderBy to avoid index requirement\n        // orderBy('createdAt', 'desc')\n      );\n\n      return onSnapshot(requestsQuery, (snapshot) =\u003e {\n        try {\n          const requests = snapshot.docs\n            .map(doc =\u003e ({\n              id: doc.id,\n              ...doc.data(),\n              createdAt: doc.data().createdAt?.toDate(),\n              updatedAt: doc.data().updatedAt?.toDate()\n            } as FollowRequest))\n            .filter(request =\u003e request.status === 'pending' \u0026\u0026 request.createdAt) // Filter in memory, only with valid createdAt\n            .sort((a, b) =\u003e b.createdAt.getTime() - a.createdAt.getTime()); // Sort in memory\n          console.log('[SocialService] Outgoing follow requests updated:', requests.length);\n          callback(requests);\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.error('[SocialService] Error processing outgoing follow requests snapshot:', error);\n          callback([]);\n        }\n      }, (error) =\u003e {\n        console.error('[SocialService] Outgoing follow requests listener error:', error);\n        callback([]);\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[SocialService] Error setting up outgoing follow requests listener:', error);\n      return () =\u003e {};\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  // Real-time Listeners\n  static subscribeToFollowRequests(userId: string, callback: (requests: FollowRequest[]) =\u003e void) {\n    try {\n      console.log('[SocialService] Setting up follow requests listener for user:', userId);\n      const requestsQuery = query(\n        collection(db, 'followRequests'),\n        where('toUserId', '==', userId),\n        where('status', '==', 'pending'),\n        orderBy('createdAt', 'desc')\n      );\n\n      return onSnapshot(requestsQuery, (snapshot) =\u003e {\n        try {\n          const requests = snapshot.docs.map(doc =\u003e ({\n            id: doc.id,\n            ...doc.data(),\n            createdAt: doc.data().createdAt?.toDate(),\n            updatedAt: doc.data().updatedAt?.toDate()\n          })) as FollowRequest[];\n          console.log('[SocialService] Follow requests updated:', requests.length);\n          callback(requests);\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.error('[SocialService] Error processing follow requests snapshot:', error);\n          callback([]);\n        }\n      }, (error) =\u003e {\n        console.error('[SocialService] Follow requests listener error:', error);\n        callback([]);\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[SocialService] Error setting up follow requests listener:', error);\n      return () =\u003e {};\n    }\n  }",

        "contents": "export class SocialService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  private static async executeActivityFeedQuery(userId: string, itemLimit: number): Promise\u003cActivityFeedItem[]\u003e {\n    try {\n      console.log('[SocialService] Executing optimized activity feed query for user:', userId);\n      \n      // Use a single, efficient query with better performance\n      // Focus on recent public activities for better performance\n      const now = new Date();\n      const twoDaysAgo = new Date(now.getTime() - 2 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000); // Reduced to 2 days\n      \n      const feedQuery = query(\n        collection(db, 'activityFeed'),\n        where('isPublic', '==', true),\n        where('createdAt', '\u003e=', twoDaysAgo),\n        orderBy('createdAt', 'desc'),\n        limit(itemLimit)\n      );\n      \n      const snapshot = await getDocs(feedQuery);\n      const items = snapshot.docs.map(doc =\u003e ({\n        id: doc.id,\n        ...doc.data(),\n        createdAt: doc.data().createdAt?.toDate()\n      })) as ActivityFeedItem[];\n      \n      console.log('[SocialService] Retrieved', items.length, 'activity feed items (optimized single query)');\n      return items;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error executing activity feed query:', error);\n      \n      // Fallback to simplest query if the optimized one fails\n      try {\n        console.log('[SocialService] Falling back to simple query...');\n        const fallbackQuery = query(\n          collection(db, 'activityFeed'),\n          where('isPublic', '==', true),\n          orderBy('createdAt', 'desc'),\n          limit(itemLimit)\n        );\n        \n        const snapshot = await getDocs(fallbackQuery);\n        const items = snapshot.docs.map(doc =\u003e ({\n          id: doc.id,\n          ...doc.data(),\n          createdAt: doc.data().createdAt?.toDate()\n        })) as ActivityFeedItem[];\n        \n        console.log('[SocialService] Fallback query returned', items.length, 'items');\n        return items;\n      } catch (fallbackError) {\n        console.error('Error in fallback query:', fallbackError);\n        throw error;\n      }\n    }",

        "contents": "export class SocialService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  static subscribeToFollowers(userId: string, callback: (follows: Follow[]) =\u003e void) {\n    try {\n      console.log('[SocialService] Setting up followers listener for user:', userId);\n      const followersQuery = query(\n        collection(db, 'follows'),\n        where('followingId', '==', userId),\n        where('status', '==', 'active'),\n        orderBy('createdAt', 'desc')\n      );\n\n      return onSnapshot(followersQuery, (snapshot) =\u003e {\n        try {\n          const follows = snapshot.docs.map(doc =\u003e {\n            const data = doc.data();\n            return {\n              id: doc.id,\n              followerId: data.followerId || '',\n              followingId: data.followingId || '',\n              status: data.status || 'active',\n              createdAt: data.createdAt?.toDate() || new Date(),\n              lastInteraction: data.lastInteraction?.toDate()\n            } as Follow;\n          });\n          console.log('[SocialService] Followers updated:', follows.length);\n          callback(follows);\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.error('[SocialService] Error processing followers snapshot:', error);\n          callback([]);\n        }\n      }, (error) =\u003e {\n        console.error('[SocialService] Followers listener error:', error);\n        callback([]);\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[SocialService] Error setting up followers listener:', error);\n      return () =\u003e {};\n    }\n  }",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  static subscribeToFollowers(userId: string, callback: (follows: Follow[]) =\u003e void) {\n    try {\n      console.log('[SocialService] Setting up followers listener for user:', userId);\n      const followersQuery = query(\n        collection(db, 'follows'),\n        where('followingId', '==', userId),\n        where('status', '==', 'active'),\n        orderBy('createdAt', 'desc')\n      );\n\n      return onSnapshot(followersQuery, (snapshot) =\u003e {\n        try {\n          const follows = snapshot.docs.map(doc =\u003e {\n            const data = doc.data();\n            return {\n              id: doc.id,\n              followerId: data.followerId || '',\n              followingId: data.followingId || '',\n              status: data.status || 'active',\n              createdAt: data.createdAt?.toDate() || new Date(),\n              lastInteraction: data.lastInteraction?.toDate()\n            } as Follow;\n          });\n          console.log('[SocialService] Followers updated:', follows.length);\n          callback(follows);\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.error('[SocialService] Error processing followers snapshot:', error);\n          callback([]);\n        }\n      }, (error) =\u003e {\n        console.error('[SocialService] Followers listener error:', error);\n        callback([]);\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[SocialService] Error setting up followers listener:', error);\n      return () =\u003e {};\n    }\n  }",

        "contents": "export class MessagingService {\n  ...\n  static subscribeToConversations(\n    userId: string, \n    callback: (conversations: ConversationSummary[]) =\u003e void\n  ): () =\u003e void {\n\n\n    ...\n\n\n    const receivedUnsubscribe = onSnapshot(receivedMessagesQuery, async (snapshot) =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const receivedConversations = await Promise.all(\n          snapshot.docs.map(async (doc) =\u003e {\n            const data = doc.data();\n            const senderId = data.senderId;\n            \n            // Get user profile\n            const userProfile = await this.getUserProfile(senderId);\n            \n            return {\n              userId: senderId,\n              userName: userProfile.displayName,\n              userAvatar: userProfile.avatarUrl,\n              userRole: userProfile.role,\n              userCompany: userProfile.company,\n              userLocation: userProfile.location,\n              lastMessage: data.content,\n              lastMessageTime: data.timestamp?.toDate?.() || new Date(),\n              unreadCount: 0, // TODO: Calculate unread count\n              isOnline: false,\n              lastSeen: undefined\n            } as ConversationSummary;\n          })\n        );\n\n        allConversations = receivedConversations;\n\n        // Get sent conversations from cache to combine\n        const sentConversations = this.conversationCache.get(userId) || [];\n\n        // Combine and sort\n        const combinedConversations = [...sentConversations, ...receivedConversations]\n          .filter((conv, index, arr) =\u003e \n            arr.findIndex(c =\u003e c.userId === conv.userId) === index\n          )\n          .sort((a, b) =\u003e {\n            if (!a.lastMessageTime \u0026\u0026 !b.lastMessageTime) return 0;\n            if (!a.lastMessageTime) return 1;\n            if (!b.lastMessageTime) return -1;\n            return b.lastMessageTime.getTime() -         "originalContents": "\n\n    const receivedUnsubscribe = onSnapshot(receivedMessagesQuery, async (snapshot) =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const receivedConversations = await Promise.all(\n          snapshot.docs.map(async (doc) =\u003e {\n            const data = doc.data();\n            const senderId = data.senderId;\n            \n            // Get user profile\n            const userProfile = await this.getUserProfile(senderId);\n            \n            return {\n              userId: senderId,\n              userName: userProfile.displayName,\n              userAvatar: userProfile.avatarUrl,\n              userRole: userProfile.role,\n              userCompany: userProfile.company,\n              userLocation: userProfile.location,\n              lastMessage: data.content,\n              lastMessageTime: data.timestamp?.toDate?.() || new Date(),\n              unreadCount: 0, // TODO: Calculate unread count\n              isOnline: false,\n              lastSeen: undefined\n            } as ConversationSummary;\n          })\n        );\n\n        allConversations = receivedConversations;\n\n        // Get sent conversations from cache to combine\n        const sentConversations = this.conversationCache.get(userId) || [];\n\n        // Combine and sort\n        const combinedConversations = [...sentConversations, ...receivedConversations]\n          .filter((conv, index, arr) =\u003e \n            arr.findIndex(c =\u003e c.userId === conv.userId) === index\n          )\n          .sort((a, b) =\u003e {\n            if (!a.lastMessageTime \u0026\u0026 !b.lastMessageTime) return 0;\n            if (!a.lastMessageTime) return 1;\n            if (!b.lastMessageTime) return -1;\n            return b.lastMessageTime.getTime() - a.lastMessageTime.getTime();\n          });\n\n        callback(combinedConversations);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error processing received conversations:', error);\n      }\n    }, (error) =\u003e {\n      console.error('Error in received conversations listener:', error);\n    });",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "const NotificationBell: React.FC\u003cNotificationBellProps\u003e =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  const handleNotificationClick = async (notification: SocialNotification) =\u003e {\n    try {\n      // Mark as read first\n      await handleMarkAsRead(notification.id);\n      \n      // Navigate based on notification type\n      switch (notification.type) {\n        case 'follow_request':\n          // Navigate to social page to see follow requests\n          window.location.href = '/social';\n          break;\n        case 'follow_accepted':\n          // Navigate to the user's profile who accepted\n          if (notification.relatedUserId) {\n            window.location.href = &#96;/resume/${notification.relatedUserId}&#96;;\n          }\n          break;\n        case 'project_invite':\n          // Navigate to project management\n          if (notification.relatedProjectId) {\n            window.location.href = &#96;/projects/${notification.relatedProjectId}/manage&#96;;\n          }\n          break;\n        case 'message':\n          // Navigate to messaging\n          window.location.href = '/social';\n          break;\n        case 'mention':\n          // Navigate to social page for mentions\n          window.location.href = '/social';\n          break;\n        case 'like':\n        case 'comment':\n          // Navigate to social page for likes/comments\n          window.location.href = '/social';\n          break;\n        case 'project_update':\n          // Navigate to project\n          if (notification.relatedProjectId) {\n            window.location.href = &#96;/projects/${notification.relatedProjectId}&#96;;\n          }\n          break;\n        default:\n          // Default to social page\n          window.location.href = '/social';\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error handling notification click:', error);\n    }\n  };",

Here’s what’s happening with your notification system:

---

## **Where Notifications Are Written**

- **Direct message and social notifications** (e.g., new message, follow request) are written to:  
  `users/{userId}/notifications`  
  (A subcollection under each user.)

- **Application/job-related notifications** (e.g., job application, application message, status update) are also written to:  
  `users/{userId}/notifications`  
  (But may also be written to `/applicationNotifications` in some legacy or parallel code.)

---

## **Where the UI Listens for Notifications**

- The main notification listener in your UI (e.g., `NotificationBell`, `useNotifications` hook) listens to:  
  `users/{currentUser.uid}/notifications`  
  (It does **not** listen to `/applicationNotifications` or `/notifications` at the root.)

---

## **Why You See Only Application Notifications**

- **Application notifications** are being written to `users/{userId}/notifications` (and possibly `/applicationNotifications`).
- **Direct message/social notifications** may not be written at all for real users, or there may be a bug in the notification creation logic for those events.
- The `/notifications` root collection is not used for real notifications—only for demo/test data.

---

## **What to Check/Fix**

1. **Are direct message notifications being created in `users/{userId}/notifications`?**
   - If not, there may be a bug in `SocialService.createNotification` or in the code that calls it (e.g., `MessagingService.sendDirectMessage`).

2. **Are application notifications being written to both `users/{userId}/notifications` and `/applicationNotifications`?**
   - If so, your UI is only showing those in the user subcollection.

3. **Is your UI ever listening to `/applicationNotifications`?**
   - If yes, that’s legacy or parallel code and should be unified.

---

## **Recommended Next Steps**

1. **Send a direct message between two real users.**
2. **Check Firestore:**  
   - Look in `users/{receiverId}/notifications` for a new notification.
   - If it’s not there, check the console for errors or permission issues.
3. **If the notification is missing:**  
   - Add logging or breakpoints in `SocialService.createNotification` and `MessagingService.sendDirectMessage` to ensure the notification creation code is being called and not failing silently.

---

## **Summary Table**

| Event Type         | Firestore Path for Notification         | UI Listens? | Working? |
|--------------------|----------------------------------------|-------------|----------|
| Direct Message     | users/{userId}/notifications           | Yes         | ❓       |
| Application Event  | users/{userId}/notifications           | Yes         | ✅       |
| Application Event  | /applicationNotifications (legacy?)    | No          | (Legacy) |
| Demo/Test          | /notifications (root)                  | No          | (Demo)   |

_**Agent (2025-07-23 18:49:00Z)**_

Absolutely! Here’s a **best-practice, sustainable approach** for notifications in a modern, scalable React + Firebase app like yours:

---

## **1. Use a Single Source of Truth for Notifications**

- **All notifications (messages, job applications, social, etc.) should be stored in one place:**  
  `users/{userId}/notifications`
- **Do not use root-level collections** like `/notifications` or `/applicationNotifications` for user-specific notifications.  
  (Root-level collections are fine for global system notifications, but not for per-user events.)

---

## **2. Notification Document Structure**

Each notification document in `users/{userId}/notifications` should have:
- `type`: e.g., `"message"`, `"job_application"`, `"application_message"`, `"status_update"`, etc.
- `title`: Short title for the notification.
- `message`: The main notification text.
- `isRead`: Boolean, whether the user has read it.
- `createdAt`: Timestamp.
- `relatedId`/`relatedUserId`/`relatedProjectId`/etc.: For navigation/context.
- `actionUrl`: (optional) Where to navigate on click.

**Example:**
```json
{
  "type": "message",
  "title": "New Message",
  "message": "You have a new message from Alice.",
  "isRead": false,
  "createdAt": ...,
  "relatedUserId": "aliceUid",
  "actionUrl": "/chat/aliceUid"
}
```

---

## **3. Notification Creation**

- **Always use a single utility/service** (e.g., `SocialService.createNotification`) to create notifications.
- **Call this utility** from anywhere in your backend or frontend where a notification is needed (e.g., after sending a message, applying to a job, etc.).
- **Write to `users/{userId}/notifications`** only.

---

## **4. Real-Time Notification Listener**

- **Listen to `users/{currentUser.uid}/notifications`** in your React app using Firestore’s `onSnapshot`.
- **Update the UI in real time** as notifications are added/updated.
- **Mark as read** by updating the `isRead` field.

---

## **5. Notification UI**

- **Show unread count** (e.g., badge on bell icon).
- **Display notifications in a dropdown or panel.**
- **Allow marking as read, deleting, and clicking to navigate.**
- **Filter/group by type if needed.**

---

## **6. Clean Up Legacy/Parallel Code**

- **Remove or migrate any code that writes to `/applicationNotifications` or `/notifications` at the root.**
- **Update all notification listeners in the UI to use the user subcollection.**
- **Migrate any old notifications if needed (optional, for historical data).**

---

## **7. Firestore Security Rules**

- **Only allow users to read/write their own notifications:**
```js
match /users/{userId}/notifications/{notificationId} {
  allow read, write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId;
}
```

---

## **8. Testing and Monitoring**

- **Test all notification types** (messages, job apps, status updates, etc.) to ensure they appear in the correct user’s notifications.
- **Add logging** in your notification creation utility to catch and debug any failures.
- **Monitor Firestore for growth**—consider archiving/deleting old notifications if needed.

---

## **Migration Plan (if needed):**

1. **Update all notification creation code** to use the unified path.
2. **Update all UI listeners to use the unified path.**
3. **(Optional) Write a script to migrate old notifications to the new structure.**
4. **Remove legacy collections and code.**

---

## **Summary Table**

| Event Type         | Firestore Path for Notification         | UI Listens? | Best Practice? |
|--------------------|----------------------------------------|-------------|---------------|
| Direct Message     | users/{userId}/notifications           | Yes         | ✅            |
| Application Event  | users/{userId}/notifications           | Yes         | ✅            |
| Social Event       | users/{userId}/notifications           | Yes         | ✅            |
| Legacy/Demo        | /applicationNotifications, /notifications | No        | ❌            |

---

## **Next Steps for You**

1. **Audit your codebase:**  
   - Ensure all notification creation uses `users/{userId}/notifications`.
   - Update all listeners/UI to use this path.
2. **Test all notification flows.**
3. **Clean up legacy code/collections.**
4. **Update Firestore security rules if needed.**

---

**If you want, I can help you:**
- Audit your codebase for legacy notification paths.
- Refactor notification creation/listening code.
- Write a migration script for old notifications.

Let me know which step you’d like to tackle next, or if you want a checklist or code samples for any part!

Great! Here’s a **step-by-step refactor plan** to unify and future-proof your notification system:

---

## **Step 1: Refactor Notification Creation**

**Goal:**  
All notifications (messages, job apps, social, etc.) should be created in `users/{userId}/notifications`.

### **A. Update All Notification Creation Calls**

- **Find all places** in your codebase that call `addDoc(collection(db, ...), ...)` for notifications.
- **Update them to:**  
  ```js
  addDoc(collection(db, 'users', userId, 'notifications'), { ...notificationData });
  ```
- **Remove any code** that writes to `/applicationNotifications` or `/notifications` at the root.

### **B. Standardize Notification Data Structure**

- Ensure every notification has:
  - `type`, `title`, `message`, `isRead`, `createdAt`
  - Any relevant `relatedId`, `actionUrl`, etc.

---

## **Step 2: Refactor Notification Listeners in the UI**

**Goal:**  
All notification UIs should listen to `users/{currentUser.uid}/notifications`.

### **A. Update All Listeners**

- In hooks/components (e.g., `useNotifications`, `NotificationBell`), ensure you use:
  ```js
  const q = query(
    collection(db, "users", currentUser.uid, "notifications"),
    orderBy("createdAt", "desc")
  );
  ```
- Remove any listeners to `/applicationNotifications` or `/notifications` at the root.

---

## **Step 3: Clean Up Legacy Code**

- **Delete or comment out** any code that references `/applicationNotifications` or `/notifications` at the root.
- **Remove any UI** that listens to or displays notifications from those collections.

---

## **Step 4: Test All Notification Flows**

- **Send a direct message:**  
  - Confirm notification appears in the recipient’s `users/{userId}/notifications`.
- **Apply to a job:**  
  - Confirm notification appears for the job poster.
- **Change application status:**  
  - Confirm notification appears for the applicant.
- **Check notification UI:**  
  - Confirm all notifications show up in the bell/dropdown/panel.

---

## **Step 5: Firestore Security Rules**

- Ensure your rules allow users to read/write only their own notifications:
  ```js
  match /users/{userId}/notifications/{notificationId} {
    allow read, write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId;
  }
  ```

---

## **Step 6: (Optional) Migrate Old Notifications**

- If you want to preserve old notifications, write a script to copy them from `/applicationNotifications` or `/notifications` to the correct user subcollections.

---

## **Step 7: Remove Demo/Test Data**

- Delete any demo/test notifications in `/notifications` at the root.

---

## **Code Example: Unified Notification Creation**

```js
// In your notification utility/service
export async function createUserNotification(userId, notification) {
  await addDoc(collection(db, 'users', userId, 'notifications'), {
    ...notification,
    isRead: false,
    createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
  });
}
```

---

## **Checklist**

- [ ] All notification creation uses `users/{userId}/notifications`
- [ ] All notification listeners use `users/{userId}/notifications`
- [ ] Legacy code/collections removed
- [ ] Security rules updated
- [ ] All notification flows tested

        "originalContents": "\n\nexport interface JobPosting {\n  id: string;\n  projectId?: string; // Make projectId optional since not all jobs have projects\n  title: string;\n  department: string;\n  jobTitle: string;\n  description: string;\n  requirements: string[];\n  responsibilities: string[];\n  location: string;\n  startDate: string;\n  endDate?: string;\n  salary?: {\n    min: number;\n    max: number;\n    currency: string;\n  };\n  isRemote: boolean;\n  isUrgent: boolean;\n  postedById: string;\n  postedAt: any;\n  deadline?: string;\n  status: 'active' | 'closed' | 'draft' | 'published';\n  applicationsCount: number;\n  tags: string[];\n  // Enhanced job posting features\n  experienceLevel: 'entry' | 'mid' | 'senior' | 'executive';\n  contractType: 'full_time' | 'part_time' | 'contract' | 'freelance' | 'internship';\n  benefits?: string[];\n  perks?: string[];\n  applicationInstructions?: string;\n  requiredDocuments?: string[];\n  preferredSkills?: string[];\n  teamSize?: number;\n  projectDuration?: string;\n  travelRequirements?: string;\n  // Analytics\n  views: number;\n  saves: number;\n  shares: number;\n  // Application tracking\n  applications?: JobApplication[];\n  shortlistedCount: number;\n  interviewedCount: number;\n  hiredCount: number;\n  // Contact and project information\n  contactName?: string;\n  contactEmail?: string;\n  showContactEmail?: boolean; // Control whether to display email publicly\n  projectName?: string;\n  projectType?: string;\n  // Work arrangement details\n  isPaid?: boolean;\n  isUnion?: boolean;\n  visaSponsorship?: boolean;\n  relocationAssistance?: boolean;\n}",
        "range": {

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\nconst JobPosterAnalytics: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [jobs, setJobs] = useState\u003cJobPosting[]\u003e([]);\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cJobApplication[]\u003e([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    // Listen to jobs posted by current user\n    const jobsQuery = query(collection(db, 'jobPostings'), where('postedById', '==', currentUser.uid));\n    const unsubscribeJobs = onSnapshot(jobsQuery, (snapshot) =\u003e {\n      const jobsData = snapshot.docs.map(doc =\u003e ({ id: doc.id, ...doc.data() } as JobPosting));\n      setJobs(jobsData);\n    });\n    // Listen to all applications for jobs posted by current user\n    const appsQuery = query(collection(db, 'jobApplications'), where('posterId', '==', currentUser.uid));\n    const unsubscribeApps = onSnapshot(appsQuery, (snapshot) =\u003e {\n      const appsData = snapshot.docs.map(doc =\u003e ({ id: doc.id, ...doc.data() } as JobApplication));\n      setApplications(appsData);\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    });\n    return () =\u003e {\n      unsubscribeJobs();\n      unsubscribeApps();\n    };\n  }, [currentUser]);",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst JobPosterAnalytics: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [jobs, setJobs] = useState\u003cJobPosting[]\u003e([]);\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState\u003cJobApplication[]\u003e([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!currentUser) return;\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    // Listen to jobs posted by current user\n    const jobsQuery = query(collection(db, 'jobPostings'), where('postedById', '==', currentUser.uid));\n    const unsubscribeJobs = onSnapshot(jobsQuery, (snapshot) =\u003e {\n      const jobsData = snapshot.docs.map(doc =\u003e ({ id: doc.id, ...doc.data() } as JobPosting));\n      setJobs(jobsData);\n    });\n    // Listen to all applications for jobs posted by current user\n    const appsQuery = query(collection(db, 'jobApplications'), where('posterId', '==', currentUser.uid));\n    const unsubscribeApps = onSnapshot(appsQuery, (snapshot) =\u003e {\n      const appsData = snapshot.docs.map(doc =\u003e ({ id: doc.id, ...doc.data() } as JobApplication));\n      setApplications(appsData);\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    });\n    return () =\u003e {\n      unsubscribeJobs();\n      unsubscribeApps();\n    };\n  }, [currentUser]);",

        "contents": "\n\nconst JobApplicationForm: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { jobId } = useParams\u003c{ jobId: string }\u003e();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  \n  const [job, setJob] = useState\u003cJobPosting | null\u003e(null);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null);\n  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);\n  \n  const [formData, setFormData] = useState\u003cJobApplicationFormData\u003e({\n    coverLetter: '',\n    expectedSalary: undefined,\n    availabilityDate: '',\n    notes: '',\n    resumeFile: null,\n    resumeUploaded: null,\n    attachments: [],\n    attachmentsUploaded: []\n  });\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (jobId) {\n      loadJobDetails();\n    }\n  }, [jobId]);\n\n  const loadJobDetails = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setIsLoading(true);\n      const jobDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'jobPostings', jobId!));\n      \n      if (jobDoc.exists()) {\n        setJob({\n          id: jobDoc.id,\n          ...jobDoc.data()\n        } as JobPosting);\n      } else {\n        setError('Job not found');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading job details:', error);\n      setError('Failed to load job details');\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleInputChange = (field: keyof JobApplicationFormData, value: any) =\u003e {\n    setFormData(prev =\u003e ({\n      ...prev,\n      [field]: value\n    }));\n  };\n\n  const handleFileUpload = (files: File[]) =\u003e {\n    setFormData(prev =\u003e ({\n      ...prev,\n      attachments: [...prev.attachments, ...files]\n    }));\n  };\n\n  const validateForm = (): boolean =\u003e {\n    // All fields are now optional - just check if user is authenticated\n    if (!currentUser) {\n      setError('You must be logged in to apply');\n      return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n  };",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export class JobApplicationService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  static async updateApplicationStatus(applicationId: string, status: JobApplication['status'], notes?: string): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n    try {\n      console.log('[JobApplicationService] Updating application status:', applicationId, 'to', status);\n      \n      const updateData: any = {\n        status,\n        lastUpdated: serverTimestamp()\n      };\n\n      if (status === 'reviewed') {\n        updateData.reviewedAt = serverTimestamp();\n      }\n\n      if (notes) {\n        updateData.notes = notes;\n      }\n\n      await updateDoc(doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId), updateData);\n\n      // Create notification for the applicant\n      const application = await this.getApplication(applicationId);\n      if (application) {\n        await this.createStatusUpdateNotification(applicationId, application.applicantId, status);\n      }\n\n      console.log('[JobApplicationService] Application status updated successfully');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error updating application status:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  static async updateApplicationStatus(applicationId: string, status: JobApplication['status'], notes?: string): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n    try {\n      console.log('[JobApplicationService] Updating application status:', applicationId, 'to', status);\n      \n      const updateData: any = {\n        status,\n        lastUpdated: serverTimestamp()\n      };\n\n      if (status === 'reviewed') {\n        updateData.reviewedAt = serverTimestamp();\n      }\n\n      if (notes) {\n        updateData.notes = notes;\n      }\n\n      await updateDoc(doc(db, 'jobApplications', applicationId), updateData);\n\n      // Create notification for the applicant\n      const application = await this.getApplication(applicationId);\n      if (application) {\n        await this.createStatusUpdateNotification(applicationId, application.applicantId, status);\n      }\n\n      console.log('[JobApplicationService] Application status updated successfully');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error updating application status:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }",

_**Agent**_

Here’s how to **refactor direct message notifications** to emulate the robust, sustainable pattern used for job application notifications:

---

## **Model: Job Application Notification**

**What it does:**
- When a job application is submitted, a notification is created in the job poster’s subcollection:  
  `users/{postedById}/notifications`
- The notification includes fields like `type`, `message`, `timestamp`, `read`, `userId`, `relatedId`, etc.

**Example:**
```js
await addDoc(collection(db, 'users', postedById, 'notifications'), {
  type: 'job_application',
  message: "You have a new job application for 'Job Title'",
  timestamp: serverTimestamp(),
  read: false,
  userId: postedById,
  relatedId: jobId,
  applicationId: applicationId,
  applicantId: applicantId,
  extra: { applicantId, jobId }
});
```

---

## **Refactor: Direct Message Notification**

**Goal:**  
When a direct message is sent, create a notification in the recipient’s subcollection:  
`users/{receiverId}/notifications`

**Fields to include:**
- `type: 'message'`
- `title: 'New Message'`
- `message: 'You have a new message from {senderName}'`
- `timestamp: serverTimestamp()`
- `read: false`
- `userId: receiverId`
- `relatedUserId: senderId`
- `actionUrl: '/chat/{senderId}'` (optional, for navigation)

---

### **Refactored Code Example**

**In your MessagingService or wherever you send a direct message:**
```js
import { addDoc, collection, serverTimestamp } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { db } from '../firebase';

async function sendDirectMessage(senderId, receiverId, content, senderName) {
  // ...existing message sending logic...

  // Create notification for the receiver
  await addDoc(collection(db, 'users', receiverId, 'notifications'), {
    type: 'message',
    title: 'New Message',
    message: `You have a new message from ${senderName}`,
    timestamp: serverTimestamp(),
    read: false,
    userId: receiverId,
    relatedUserId: senderId,
    actionUrl: `/chat/${senderId}`
  });
}
```

---

### **Best Practice Checklist**

- [x] **All notifications go to `users/{userId}/notifications`**
- [x] **Consistent fields for all notification types**
- [x] **UI listens to this subcollection for real-time updates**
- [x] **No root-level `/notifications` or `/applicationNotifications` for user-specific events**
- [x] **Security rules restrict access to the user’s own notifications**

---

## **Next Steps**

1. **Update your direct message sending logic to include the notification creation as shown above.**
2. **Test by sending a direct message and confirming the notification appears in Firestore and in your UI.**
3. **Repeat for any other notification types that need to be unified.**

---

        "originalContents": "\n\nexport class MessagingService {\n  private static listeners = new Map\u003cstring, () =\u003e void\u003e();\n  private static messageCache = new Map\u003cstring, DirectMessage[]\u003e();\n  private static conversationCache = new Map\u003cstring, ConversationSummary[]\u003e();\n  private static typingUsers = new Map\u003cstring, Set\u003cstring\u003e\u003e();\n\n  // ===== DIRECT MESSAGE OPERATIONS =====\n  \n  static async sendDirectMessage(\n    senderId: string, \n    receiverId: string, \n    content: string, \n    messageType: 'text' | 'image' | 'file' | 'voice' | 'project_invite' = 'text', \n    relatedProjectId?: string,\n    fileUrl?: string\n  ): Promise\u003cstring\u003e {\n    try {\n      console.log('[MessagingService] Sending direct message from', senderId, 'to', receiverId);\n      \n      // Check permissions\n      const canMessage = await this.canSendMessage(senderId, receiverId);\n      if (!canMessage) {\n        throw new Error('Cannot send message to this user. They may not allow messages from non-followers.');\n      }\n\n      // Create message data, filtering out undefined values\n      const messageData: any = {\n        senderId,\n        receiverId,\n        content,\n        messageType,\n        timestamp: serverTimestamp(),\n        isRead: false,\n        reactions: [],\n        status: 'sent'\n      };\n\n      // Only add relatedProjectId if it's defined\n      if (relatedProjectId) {\n        messageData.relatedProjectId = relatedProjectId;\n      }\n      // Only add fileUrl if it's defined and not too long\n      if (fileUrl) {\n        // Check if fileUrl is too long for Firestore (limit to 500KB to be safe)\n        if (fileUrl.length \u003e 500 * 1024) {\n          console.warn('[MessagingService] File URL too long, truncating:', fileUrl.length, 'bytes');\n          messageData.fileUrl = &#96;FILE_TOO_LARGE:${fileUrl.split('/').pop() || 'file'}&#96;;\n        } else {\n          messageData.fileUrl = fileUrl;\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Add to Firestore\n      const docRef = await addDoc(collection(db, 'directMessages'), messageData);",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export class MessagingService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  private static async getUserProfile(userId: string) {\n    try {\n      // Try to get from users collection first\n      const userDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', userId));\n      if (userDoc.exists()) {\n        const userData = userDoc.data();\n        return {\n          displayName: userData.displayName || userData.firstName || userData.lastName || &#96;User ${userId.slice(-4)}&#96;,\n          avatarUrl: userData.avatarUrl || userData.photoURL,\n          role: userData.role,\n          company: userData.company,\n          location: userData.location\n        };\n      }\n\n      // Try crewProfiles collection as fallback\n      const crewDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'crewProfiles', userId));\n      if (crewDoc.exists()) {\n        const crewData = crewDoc.data();\n        return {\n          displayName: crewData.name || crewData.firstName || crewData.lastName || &#96;Crew Member ${userId.slice(-4)}&#96;,\n          avatarUrl: crewData.profileImageUrl || crewData.avatarUrl,\n          role: crewData.role,\n          company: crewData.company,\n          location: crewData.residences?.[0]?.city || crewData.location\n        };\n      }\n\n      // If no user data found, return a fallback\n      return {\n        displayName: &#96;User ${userId.slice(-4)}&#96;,\n        avatarUrl: undefined,\n        role: 'Crew Member',\n        company: undefined,\n        location: undefined\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error getting user profile:', error);\n      return {\n        displayName: &#96;User ${userId.slice(-4)}&#96;,\n        avatarUrl: undefined,\n        role: 'Crew Member',\n        company: undefined,\n        location: undefined\n      };\n    }\n  }",

error.name : 'Unknown',\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',\n        stack: error instanceof Error ? error.stack : 'No stack trace'\n      });\n      \n      // Check if it's a size-related error\n      const isSizeError = error instanceof Error \u0026\u0026 error.message.includes('exceeds maximum allowed size');\n      const isPermissionError = error instanceof Error \u0026\u0026 (\n        error.message.includes('unauthorized') || \n        error.message.includes('permission') ||\n        error.message.includes('403')\n      );\n      \n      if (isSizeError) {\n        // If it's a size error, use placeholder\n        console.warn('[MessagingService] File size error, using placeholder');\n        return &#96;FILE_TOO_LARGE:${file.name}&#96;;\n      }\n      \n      if (isPermissionError) {\n        // If it's a permission error, use data URL fallback for small files\n        console.warn('[MessagingService] Storage permission error, trying data URL fallback');\n        const maxDataUrlSize = 300 * 1024; // 300KB for permission errors\n        if (file.size \u003c= maxDataUrlSize) {\n          return new Promise((resolve) =\u003e {\n            const reader = new FileReader();\n            reader.onload = () =\u003e {\n              const dataUrl = reader.result as string;\n              if (dataUrl.length \u003e 500 * 1024) {\n                console.warn('[MessagingService] Data URL too long, using placeholder');\n                resolve(&#96;UPLOAD_FAILED:${file.name}&#96;);\n              } else {\n                console.log('[MessagingService] Using data URL fallback for permission error');\n                resolve(dataUrl);\n              }\n            };\n            reader.readAsDataURL(file);\n          });\n        } else {\n          return &#96;UPLOAD_FAILED:${file.name}&#96;;\n        }\n      }",

        "originalContents": "  const searchUsers = async (queryStr: string) =\u003e {\n    if (!queryStr.trim()) {\n      setUserSearchResults([]);\n      return;\n    }\n    setIsSearchingUsers(true);\n    // Do NOT clear userSearchResults here; keep previous results while loading\n    try {\n      let allResults: UserSearchResult[] = [];\n      if (approvedContacts.length \u003e 0) {\n        // Fetch all approved contacts' user docs in chunks of 10\n        const usersRef = collection(db, 'users');\n        const approvedChunks = [];\n        for (let i = 0; i \u003c approvedContacts.length; i += 10) {\n          approvedChunks.push(approvedContacts.slice(i, i + 10));\n        }\n        for (const chunk of approvedChunks) {\n          const q = query(usersRef, where('id', 'in', chunk));\n          const snap = await getDocs(q);\n          allResults = allResults.concat(\n            snap.docs.map(doc =\u003e ({\n              id: doc.id,\n              name: doc.data().displayName || doc.data().name || &#96;User ${doc.id.slice(-4)}&#96;,\n              email: doc.data().email || '',\n              avatar: doc.data().avatarUrl || doc.data().avatar || '',\n              role: doc.data().role || 'User',\n              company: doc.data().company || ''\n            }))\n          );\n        }\n      } else {\n        // Fallback: search all users\n        const usersRef = collection(db, 'users');\n        const snap = await getDocs(usersRef);\n        console.log('[CollabModal] Fallback: found', snap.docs.length, 'users in Firestore');\n        allResults = snap.docs.map(doc =\u003e ({\n          id: doc.id,\n          name: doc.data().displayName || doc.data().name || &#96;User ${doc.id.slice(-4)}&#96;,\n          email: doc.data().email || '',\n          avatar: doc.data().avatarUrl || doc.data().avatar || '',\n          role: doc.data().role || 'User',\n          company: doc.data().company || ''\n        }));\n        if (allResults.length === 0) {\n          console.warn('[CollabModal] No users found in Firestore users collection.');\n        }\n      }\n",

        "contents": "\n\nconst EnhancedTasksHub: React.FC\u003cEnhancedTasksHubProps\u003e = ({ projectId }) =\u003e {\n  // State\n  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState\u003cCollaborativeTask[]\u003e([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState\u003cboolean\u003e(true);\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null);\n  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState\u003cViewMode\u003e('list');\n  const [selectedTask, setSelectedTask] = useState\u003cCollaborativeTask | null\u003e(null);\n  const [showTaskForm, setShowTaskForm] = useState\u003cboolean\u003e(false);\n  const [editingTask, setEditingTask] = useState\u003cCollaborativeTask | undefined\u003e(undefined);\n  const [users, setUsers] = useState\u003cRecord\u003cstring, UserData\u003e\u003e({});\n  const [filters, setFilters] = useState\u003cTaskFilters\u003e({\n    status: 'all',\n    priority: 'all',\n    category: 'all',\n    searchTerm: '',\n    assignedToMe: false\n  });\n\n  // Load users\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    const loadUsers = async () =\u003e {\n      try {\n        // Use crewProfiles collection instead of users (single source of truth)\n        const crewQuery = query(collection(db, 'crewProfiles'), where('isPublished', '==', true));\n        const snapshot = await getDocs(crewQuery);\n        const usersData: Record\u003cstring, UserData\u003e = {};\n        \n        snapshot.docs.forEach((doc: any) =\u003e {\n          const crewData = doc.data();\n          usersData[doc.id] = {\n            id: doc.id,\n            name: crewData.name || crewData.displayName || (crewData.email ? crewData.email.split('@')[0] : 'Crew Member'),\n            email: crewData.email || '',\n            avatar: crewData.profileImageUrl || crewData.photoURL\n          };\n        });\n        \n        setUsers(usersData);\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error('Error loading users:', err);\n        setError('Failed to load users');\n      }\n    };\n\n    loadUsers();\n  }, []);",

        "contents": "const CollaborativeTasksHub: React.FC\u003cCollaborativeTasksHubProps\u003e =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  const loadUsers = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      // Use crewProfiles collection instead of users (single source of truth)\n      const crewQuery = query(collection(db, 'crewProfiles'), where('isPublished', '==', true));\n      const snapshot = await getDocs(crewQuery);\n      const usersData: {[key: string]: {name: string, email: string, avatar?: string}} = {};\n      snapshot.docs.forEach(doc =\u003e {\n        const crewData = doc.data();\n        usersData[doc.id] = {\n          name: crewData.name || crewData.displayName || crewData.email || 'Unknown Crew Member',\n          email: crewData.email || '',\n          avatar: crewData.profileImageUrl || crewData.photoURL || undefined\n        };\n      });\n      setUsers(usersData);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error loading users:', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const loadTasks = () =\u003e {\n    setLoading(true);\n    const tasksQuery = query(\n      collection(db, 'collaborativeTasks'),\n      where('projectId', '==', projectId)\n    );\n\n    const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(tasksQuery, (snapshot) =\u003e {\n      const tasksData = snapshot.docs.map(doc =\u003e ({\n        id: doc.id,\n        ...doc.data()\n      })) as CollaborativeTask[];\n      \n      // Sort tasks in memory to handle optional dueDate\n      tasksData.sort((a, b) =\u003e {\n        if (!a.dueDate \u0026\u0026 !b.dueDate) return 0;\n        if (!a.dueDate) return 1;\n        if (!b.dueDate) return -1;\n        return new Date(a.dueDate).getTime() - new Date(b.dueDate).getTime();\n      });\n      \n      console.log('Loaded tasks:', tasksData);\n      setTasks(tasksData);\n      setLoading(false);\n    }, (error) =\u003e {\n      console.error('Error loading tasks:', error);\n      setLoading(false);\n    });\n\n    return unsubscribe;\n  };",

        "contents": "const DebugJobsPage =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  // Fetch jobs from the specified collection\n  const fetchAllJobs = async (collectionToCheck = collectionName) =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n      console.log(&#96;Fetching all jobs from collection '${collectionToCheck}'...&#96;);\n      const db = getFirestore();\n      const jobsRef = collection(db, collectionToCheck);\n      const querySnapshot = await getDocs(jobsRef);\n      \n      console.log(&#96;Found ${querySnapshot.size} jobs in collection '${collectionToCheck}'&#96;);\n      \n      const jobsData = await Promise.all(querySnapshot.docs.map(async docSnapshot =\u003e {\n        const data = docSnapshot.data();\n        const jobData: JobData = {\n          id: docSnapshot.id,\n          ...data,\n          // Convert Firestore timestamps to readable dates\n          createdAt: data.createdAt?.toDate?.() || 'No date',\n          updatedAt: data.updatedAt?.toDate?.() || 'No date',\n          // Initialize userData as undefined (will be set if user data is available)\n          userData: undefined\n        };\n        \n        // Try to get user data if postedById exists\n        if (data.postedById) {\n          try {\n            const userDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', data.postedById));\n            if (userDoc.exists()) {\n              // Explicitly type the user data\n              const userData = userDoc.data() as Record\u003cstring, unknown\u003e;\n              jobData.userData = userData;\n            }\n          } catch (userErr) {\n            console.log(&#96;Could not fetch user data for ${data.postedById}:&#96;, userErr);\n          }\n        }\n        \n        return jobData;\n      }));\n      \n      setJobs(jobsData);\n      console.log('Jobs data:', jobsData);\n      setError(null);\n    } catch (err) {\n      const errorMessage = &#96;Error fetching jobs from '${collectionToCheck}': ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}&#96;;\n      console.error(errorMessage, err);\n      setError(errorMessage);\n      setJobs([]);\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export class MessagingService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  private static async getUserProfile(userId: string) {\n    try {\n      // Try to get from users collection first\n      const userDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', userId));\n      if (userDoc.exists()) {\n        const userData = userDoc.data();\n        return {\n          displayName: userData.displayName || userData.firstName || userData.lastName || &#96;User ${userId.slice(-4)}&#96;,\n          avatarUrl: userData.avatarUrl || userData.photoURL,\n          role: userData.role,\n          company: userData.company,\n          location: userData.location\n        };\n      }\n\n      // Try crewProfiles collection as fallback\n      const crewDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'crewProfiles', userId));\n      if (crewDoc.exists()) {\n        const crewData = crewDoc.data();\n        return {\n          displayName: crewData.name || crewData.firstName || crewData.lastName || &#96;Crew Member ${userId.slice(-4)}&#96;,\n          avatarUrl: crewData.profileImageUrl || crewData.avatarUrl,\n          role: crewData.role,\n          company: crewData.company,\n          location: crewData.residences?.[0]?.city || crewData.location\n        };\n      }\n\n      // If no user data found, return a fallback\n      return {\n        displayName: &#96;User ${userId.slice(-4)}&#96;,\n        avatarUrl: undefined,\n        role: 'Crew Member',\n        company: undefined,\n        location: undefined\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error getting user profile:', error);\n      return {\n        displayName: &#96;User ${userId.slice(-4)}&#96;,\n        avatarUrl: undefined,\n        role: 'Crew Member',\n        company: undefined,\n        location: undefined\n      };\n    }\n  }",

        "contents": "// src/firebase.ts\nimport { initializeApp } from \"firebase/app\";\nimport { getAuth } from \"firebase/auth\";\nimport { \n  Firestore as FirestoreType, \n  initializeFirestore, \n  enableNetwork,\n  serverTimestamp,\n  collection,\n  addDoc,\n  doc,\n  setDoc,\n  updateDoc,\n  deleteDoc,\n  getDocs,\n  query,\n  where,\n  orderBy,\n  limit,\n  getDoc,\n  Timestamp,\n  DocumentData,\n  QueryDocumentSnapshot,\n  FieldValue\n} from \"firebase/firestore\";\nimport { getStorage } from \"firebase/storage\";\n\nconst firebaseConfig = {\n  apiKey:     process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_API_KEY,\n  authDomain: process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN,\n  projectId:  process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID,\n  storageBucket: process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET,\n  messagingSenderId: process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID,\n  appId:      process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_APP_ID,\n};\n\nconst app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);\nconst auth = getAuth(app);\n\n// Initialize Firestore with settings to prevent internal assertion errors\nconst db = initializeFirestore(app, {\n  cacheSizeBytes: 50 * 1024 * 1024, // 50MB cache\n  experimentalForceLongPolling: true, // Use long polling instead of WebSocket\n});\n\nconst storage = getStorage(app);\n\n// Error handling for Firestore\nconst handleFirestoreError = (error: any) =\u003e {\n  console.error('Firestore error:', error);\n  // Attempt to reconnect if there's a connection issue\n  if (error.code === 'unavailable' || error.code === 'deadline-exceeded') {\n    console.log('Attempting to reconnect to Firestore...');\n    enableNetwork(db).catch(console.error);\n  }\n};",

        "originalContents": "// src/firebase.ts\nimport { initializeApp } from \"firebase/app\";\nimport { getAuth } from \"firebase/auth\";\nimport { \n  Firestore as FirestoreType, \n  initializeFirestore, \n  enableNetwork,\n  serverTimestamp,\n  collection,\n  addDoc,\n  doc,\n  setDoc,\n  updateDoc,\n  deleteDoc,\n  getDocs,\n  query,\n  where,\n  orderBy,\n  limit,\n  getDoc,\n  Timestamp,\n  DocumentData,\n  QueryDocumentSnapshot,\n  FieldValue\n} from \"firebase/firestore\";\nimport { getStorage } from \"firebase/storage\";\n\nconst firebaseConfig = {\n  apiKey:     process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_API_KEY,\n  authDomain: process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN,\n  projectId:  process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID,\n  storageBucket: process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET,\n  messagingSenderId: process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID,\n  appId:      process.env.REACT_APP_FIREBASE_APP_ID,\n};\n\nconst app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);\nconst auth = getAuth(app);\n\n// Initialize Firestore with settings to prevent internal assertion errors\nconst db = initializeFirestore(app, {\n  cacheSizeBytes: 50 * 1024 * 1024, // 50MB cache\n  experimentalForceLongPolling: true, // Use long polling instead of WebSocket\n});\n\nconst storage = getStorage(app);\n\n// Error handling for Firestore\nconst handleFirestoreError = (error: any) =\u003e {\n  console.error('Firestore error:', error);\n  // Attempt to reconnect if there's a connection issue\n  if (error.code === 'unavailable' || error.code === 'deadline-exceeded') {\n    console.log('Attempting to reconnect to Firestore...');\n    enableNetwork(db).catch(console.error);\n  }\n};",

        "originalContents": "import { \n  collection, \n  query, \n  where, \n  orderBy, \n  getDocs, \n  addDoc, \n  updateDoc, \n  doc, \n  onSnapshot, \n  serverTimestamp,\n  writeBatch,\n  getDoc,\n  deleteDoc,\n  limit,\n  Timestamp,\n  DocumentData,\n  QueryDocumentSnapshot\n} from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../firebase';\nimport { DirectMessage, ChatRoom, ChatSettings, MessageReaction, ChatPresence } from '../types/Chat';\nimport { SocialService } from './socialService';\nimport { storage } from '../firebase';\nimport { ref, uploadBytes, getDownloadURL, ref as storageRef, deleteObject } from 'firebase/storage';\n\nexport interface ConversationSummary {\n  userId: string;\n  userName: string;\n  userAvatar?: string;\n  userRole?: string;\n  userCompany?: string;\n  userLocation?: string;\n  lastMessage?: string;\n  lastMessageTime?: Date;\n  unreadCount: number;\n  isOnline?: boolean;\n  lastSeen?: Date;\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\nexport class UserUtils {\n  private static userCache = new Map\u003cstring, UserProfile | null\u003e();\n\n  static async getUserProfile(userId: string): Promise\u003cUserProfile | null\u003e {\n    try {\n      // Check cache first\n      if (this.userCache.has(userId)) {\n        return this.userCache.get(userId) || null;\n      }\n\n      // Only use crewProfiles collection (single source of truth)\n      const crewDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'crewProfiles', userId));\n      if (crewDoc.exists()) {\n        const crewData = crewDoc.data();\n        const profile: UserProfile = {\n          id: userId,\n          displayName: crewData.name || crewData.firstName || &#96;Crew Member ${userId.slice(-4)}&#96;,\n          firstName: crewData.firstName,\n          lastName: crewData.lastName,\n          email: crewData.email,\n          avatarUrl: crewData.profileImageUrl || crewData.avatarUrl, // Use profileImageUrl from crewProfiles\n          bio: crewData.bio,\n          location: crewData.residences?.[0]?.city || crewData.location,\n          jobTitle: crewData.jobTitles?.[0]?.title || crewData.jobTitle,\n          company: crewData.company\n        };\n        \n        this.userCache.set(userId, profile);\n        return profile;\n      }\n\n      // Return null if user not found\n      this.userCache.set(userId, null);\n      return null;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error fetching user profile:', error);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';\nimport { collection, getDocs } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { auth, db } from '../firebase';\nimport CrewProfileCard from '../components/CrewProfileCard';\nimport { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { LegacyCrewProfile } from '../types/CrewProfile';\n\nconst CollectionsPage: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const [savedCrew, setSavedCrew] = useState\u003cLegacyCrewProfile[]\u003e([]);\n  const [savedProjects, setSavedProjects] = useState\u003cany[]\u003e([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    const fetchCollections = async () =\u003e {\n      const user = auth.currentUser;\n      if (!user) return;\n\n      try {\n        // Fetch saved crew profiles\n        const crewSnapshot = await getDocs(\n          collection(db, &#96;collections/${user.uid}/savedCrew&#96;)\n        );\n        const crewProfiles = crewSnapshot.docs.map(doc =\u003e ({\n          id: doc.id,\n          ...doc.data()\n        })) as LegacyCrewProfile[];\n        setSavedCrew(crewProfiles);\n\n        // Fetch saved projects\n        const projectsSnapshot = await getDocs(\n          collection(db, &#96;collections/${user.uid}/savedProjects&#96;)\n        );\n        const projects = projectsSnapshot.docs.map(doc =\u003e ({\n          id: doc.id,\n          ...doc.data()\n        }));\n        setSavedProjects(projects);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error fetching collections:', error);\n      } finally {\n        setLoading(false);\n      }\n    };\n\n    fetchCollections();\n  }, []);",

        "contents": "import { doc, getDoc, setDoc, updateDoc, arrayUnion, arrayRemove } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../firebase';\n\nexport const addToCollection = async (\n  userId: string,\n  type: 'savedProjects' | 'savedCrew',\n  itemId: string\n) =\u003e {\n  const userRef = doc(db, 'UserCollections', userId);\n  const userSnap = await getDoc(userRef);\n\n  if (!userSnap.exists()) {\n    await setDoc(userRef, {\n      savedProjects: [],\n      savedCrew: [],\n      [type]: [itemId],\n    });\n  } else {\n    await updateDoc(userRef, {\n      [type]: arrayUnion(itemId),\n    });\n  }\n};",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "const RealTimeCollaboration: React.FC\u003cRealTimeCollaborationProps\u003e =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  // Listen to messages\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!session) return;\n\n    const messagesQuery = query(\n      collection(db, 'collaborationSessions', session.id, 'messages'),\n      orderBy('timestamp', 'asc')\n    );\n\n    const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(messagesQuery, (snapshot) =\u003e {\n      const newMessages = snapshot.docs.map(doc =\u003e ({\n        id: doc.id,\n        ...doc.data()\n      })) as CollaborationMessage[];\n      \n      setMessages(newMessages);\n    });\n\n    return unsubscribe;\n  }, [session]);\n\n  // Listen to active users\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!session) return;\n\n    const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(doc(db, 'collaborationSessions', session.id), (doc) =\u003e {\n      if (doc.exists()) {\n        const data = doc.data();\n        setActiveUsers(data.activeUsers || []);\n      }\n    });\n\n    return unsubscribe;\n  }, [session]);\n\n  // Handle typing indicators\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!session || !currentUser) return;\n\n    const typingRef = doc(db, 'collaborationSessions', session.id, 'typing', currentUser.uid);\n    \n    const handleTyping = () =\u003e {\n      updateDoc(typingRef, {\n        isTyping: true,\n        timestamp: serverTimestamp()\n      });\n\n      // Clear typing indicator after 3 seconds\n      setTimeout(() =\u003e {\n        updateDoc(typingRef, {\n          isTyping: false,\n          timestamp: serverTimestamp()\n        });\n      }, 3000);\n    };\n\n    const input = document.querySelector('textarea[name=\"message\"]') as HTMLTextAreaElement;\n    if (input) {\n      input.addEventListener('input', handleTyping);\n      return () =\u003e input.removeEventListener('input', handleTyping);\n    }\n  }, [session, currentUser]);",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  // Listen to messages\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!session) return;\n\n    const messagesQuery = query(\n      collection(db, 'collaborationSessions', session.id, 'messages'),\n      orderBy('timestamp', 'asc')\n    );\n\n    const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(messagesQuery, (snapshot) =\u003e {\n      const newMessages = snapshot.docs.map(doc =\u003e ({\n        id: doc.id,\n        ...doc.data()\n      })) as CollaborationMessage[];\n      \n      setMessages(newMessages);\n    });\n\n    return unsubscribe;\n  }, [session]);\n\n  // Listen to active users\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!session) return;\n\n    const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(doc(db, 'collaborationSessions', session.id), (doc) =\u003e {\n      if (doc.exists()) {\n        const data = doc.data();\n        setActiveUsers(data.activeUsers || []);\n      }\n    });\n\n    return unsubscribe;\n  }, [session]);\n\n  // Handle typing indicators\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!session || !currentUser) return;\n\n    const typingRef = doc(db, 'collaborationSessions', session.id, 'typing', currentUser.uid);\n    \n    const handleTyping = () =\u003e {\n      updateDoc(typingRef, {\n        isTyping: true,\n        timestamp: serverTimestamp()\n      });\n\n      // Clear typing indicator after 3 seconds\n      setTimeout(() =\u003e {\n        updateDoc(typingRef, {\n          isTyping: false,\n          timestamp: serverTimestamp()\n        });\n      }, 3000);\n    };\n\n    const input = document.querySelector('textarea[name=\"message\"]') as HTMLTextAreaElement;\n    if (input) {\n      input.addEventListener('input', handleTyping);\n      return () =\u003e input.removeEventListener('input', handleTyping);\n    }\n  }, [session, currentUser]);",

        "contents": "const CollaborationHub: React.FC\u003cCollaborationHubProps\u003e =\n  ...\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n\n    \n    ...\n\n    \n    // Load all screenplays for this user (uploaded or as team member)\n    const fetchScreenplays = async () =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const screenplaysRef = collection(db, 'screenplays');\n        const q1 = query(screenplaysRef, where('uploadedBy', '==', currentUser.uid));\n        const snap1 = await getDocs(q1);\n        const q2 = query(screenplaysRef, where('teamMembers', 'array-contains', currentUser.uid));\n        const snap2 = await getDocs(q2);\n        \n        // Combine and deduplicate screenplays\n        const allScreenplays = [...snap1.docs, ...snap2.docs];\n        const uniqueScreenplays = Array.from(\n          new Map(\n            allScreenplays.map(doc =\u003e {\n              const data = doc.data();\n              // Ensure we have all required fields and handle timestamps\n              const screenplay: Screenplay = {\n                id: doc.id,\n                name: data.name || 'Untitled Screenplay',\n                type: data.type || 'pdf',\n                url: data.url || '',\n                uploadedBy: data.uploadedBy,\n                teamMembers: data.teamMembers || [],\n                size: data.size,\n                // Convert Firestore timestamps to Date objects\n                uploadedAt: data.uploadedAt?.toDate ? data.uploadedAt.toDate() : data.uploadedAt,\n                lastModified: data.lastModified?.toDate ? data.lastModified.toDate() : data.lastModified\n              };\n              return [doc.id, screenplay];\n            })\n          ).values()\n        ) as Screenplay[];\n        \n        setUserScreenplays(uniqueScreenplays);\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error('Error fetching user screenplays:', err);\n      }\n    };\n    \n    fetchScreenplays();\n  }, [currentUser, projectId]);",

        "originalContents": "\n    \n    // Load all screenplays for this user (uploaded or as team member)\n    const fetchScreenplays = async () =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const screenplaysRef = collection(db, 'screenplays');\n        const q1 = query(screenplaysRef, where('uploadedBy', '==', currentUser.uid));\n        const snap1 = await getDocs(q1);\n        const q2 = query(screenplaysRef, where('teamMembers', 'array-contains', currentUser.uid));\n        const snap2 = await getDocs(q2);\n        \n        // Combine and deduplicate screenplays\n        const allScreenplays = [...snap1.docs, ...snap2.docs];\n        const uniqueScreenplays = Array.from(\n          new Map(\n            allScreenplays.map(doc =\u003e {\n              const data = doc.data();\n              // Ensure we have all required fields and handle timestamps\n              const screenplay: Screenplay = {\n                id: doc.id,\n                name: data.name || 'Untitled Screenplay',\n                type: data.type || 'pdf',\n                url: data.url || '',\n                uploadedBy: data.uploadedBy,\n                teamMembers: data.teamMembers || [],\n                size: data.size,\n                // Convert Firestore timestamps to Date objects\n                uploadedAt: data.uploadedAt?.toDate ? data.uploadedAt.toDate() : data.uploadedAt,\n                lastModified: data.lastModified?.toDate ? data.lastModified.toDate() : data.lastModified\n              };\n              return [doc.id, screenplay];\n            })\n          ).values()\n        ) as Screenplay[];\n        \n        setUserScreenplays(uniqueScreenplays);\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error('Error fetching user screenplays:', err);\n      }\n    };\n    \n    fetchScreenplays();\n  }, [currentUser, projectId]);",

        "contents": "export class MessagingService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  static subscribeToConversations(\n    userId: string, \n    callback: (conversations: ConversationSummary[]) =\u003e void\n  ): () =\u003e void {\n    console.log('[MessagingService] Subscribing to conversations for user:', userId);\n    \n    const listenerKey = &#96;conversations_${userId}&#96;;\n    \n    // Clean up existing listener\n    if (this.listeners.has(listenerKey)) {\n      this.listeners.get(listenerKey)!();\n    }\n\n    let allConversations: ConversationSummary[] = [];\n\n    // Set up real-time listener for sent messages\n    const sentMessagesQuery = query(\n      collection(db, 'directMessages'),\n      where('senderId', '==', userId),\n      orderBy('timestamp', 'desc')\n    );\n\n    const sentUnsubscribe = onSnapshot(sentMessagesQuery, async (snapshot) =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const sentConversations = await Promise.all(\n          snapshot.docs.map(async (doc) =\u003e {\n            const data = doc.data();\n            const receiverId = data.receiverId;\n            \n            // Get user profile\n            const userProfile = await this.getUserProfile(receiverId);\n            \n            return {\n              userId: receiverId,\n              userName: userProfile.displayName,\n              userAvatar: userProfile.avatarUrl,\n              userRole: userProfile.role,\n              userCompany: userProfile.company,\n              userLocation: userProfile.location,\n              lastMessage: data.content,\n              lastMessageTime: data.timestamp?.toDate?.() || new Date(),\n              unreadCount: 0, // TODO: Calculate unread count\n              isOnline: false,\n              lastSeen: undefined\n            } as ConversationSummary;\n          })\n        );",

---

## **1. Refactor All Code to Use `crewProfiles`**

- **User profiles:**  
  - Always read/write user data from `crewProfiles/{userId}`.
  - Remove any code that references `users/{userId}` for profile data.

- **Notifications:**  
  - Always write/read notifications from `crewProfiles/{userId}/notifications`.
  - Remove any code that references `users/{userId}/notifications`.

- **Other user-related subcollections:**  
  - If you have favorites, settings, etc., move them under `crewProfiles/{userId}/...` for consistency.

---

## **2. Update All Firestore Queries**

- Update all `collection(db, 'users', ...)` to `collection(db, 'crewProfiles', ...)`.
- Update all `doc(db, 'users', ...)` to `doc(db, 'crewProfiles', ...)`.
- Update all queries, listeners, and writes accordingly.

---

## **3. Update Security Rules**

- Update your Firestore security rules to protect `crewProfiles` instead of `users`:
  ```js
  match /crewProfiles/{userId}/notifications/{notificationId} {
    allow read, write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId;
  }
  ```

---

## **4. Remove the `users` Collection**

- Once you’ve refactored and tested everything, you can safely delete the `users` collection from Firestore to prevent accidental use.

---

## **5. Test All Flows**

- Test:
  - Direct messages (profile and notification reads/writes)
  - Job applications (profile and notification reads/writes)
  - Any other user-related features (favorites, settings, etc.)

---

## **6. Update Documentation/Onboarding**

- Update any developer docs or onboarding notes to clarify that `crewProfiles` is the only source of truth for user data.

---

## **7. (Optional) Migration Script**

- If you have any data in `users` you want to preserve, write a one-time migration script to copy it to `crewProfiles`.

---

## **Summary Table**

| Data Type      | Old Path                  | New Path                        |

| User Profile   | users/{userId}           | crewProfiles/{userId}           |
| Notifications  | users/{userId}/notifications | crewProfiles/{userId}/notifications |
| Favorites/etc. | users/{userId}/favorites | crewProfiles/{userId}/favorites |

        "originalContents": "  const searchUsers = async (queryStr: string) =\u003e {\n    if (!queryStr.trim()) {\n      setUserSearchResults([]);\n      return;\n    }\n    setIsSearchingUsers(true);\n    // Do NOT clear userSearchResults here; keep previous results while loading\n    try {\n      let allResults: UserSearchResult[] = [];\n      if (approvedContacts.length \u003e 0) {\n        // Fetch all approved contacts' user docs in chunks of 10\n        const usersRef = collection(db, 'users');\n        const approvedChunks = [];\n        for (let i = 0; i \u003c approvedContacts.length; i += 10) {\n          approvedChunks.push(approvedContacts.slice(i, i + 10));\n        }\n        for (const chunk of approvedChunks) {\n          const q = query(usersRef, where('id', 'in', chunk));\n          const snap = await getDocs(q);\n          allResults = allResults.concat(\n            snap.docs.map(doc =\u003e ({\n              id: doc.id,\n              name: doc.data().displayName || doc.data().name || &#96;User ${doc.id.slice(-4)}&#96;,\n              email: doc.data().email || '',\n              avatar: doc.data().avatarUrl || doc.data().avatar || '',\n              role: doc.data().role || 'User',\n              company: doc.data().company || ''\n            }))\n          );\n        }\n      } else {\n        // Fallback: search all users\n        const usersRef = collection(db, 'users');\n        const snap = await getDocs(usersRef);\n        console.log('[CollabModal] Fallback: found', snap.docs.length, 'users in Firestore');\n        allResults = snap.docs.map(doc =\u003e ({\n          id: doc.id,\n          name: doc.data().displayName || doc.data().name || &#96;User ${doc.id.slice(-4)}&#96;,\n          email: doc.data().email || '',\n          avatar: doc.data().avatarUrl || doc.data().avatar || '',\n          role: doc.data().role || 'User',\n          company: doc.data().company || ''\n        }));\n        if (allResults.length === 0) {\n          console.warn('[CollabModal] No users found in Firestore users collection.');\n        }\n      }\n",

        "contents": "const DebugJobsPage =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  // Fetch jobs from the specified collection\n  const fetchAllJobs = async (collectionToCheck = collectionName) =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n      console.log(&#96;Fetching all jobs from collection '${collectionToCheck}'...&#96;);\n      const db = getFirestore();\n      const jobsRef = collection(db, collectionToCheck);\n      const querySnapshot = await getDocs(jobsRef);\n      \n      console.log(&#96;Found ${querySnapshot.size} jobs in collection '${collectionToCheck}'&#96;);\n      \n      const jobsData = await Promise.all(querySnapshot.docs.map(async docSnapshot =\u003e {\n        const data = docSnapshot.data();\n        const jobData: JobData = {\n          id: docSnapshot.id,\n          ...data,\n          // Convert Firestore timestamps to readable dates\n          createdAt: data.createdAt?.toDate?.() || 'No date',\n          updatedAt: data.updatedAt?.toDate?.() || 'No date',\n          // Initialize userData as undefined (will be set if user data is available)\n          userData: undefined\n        };\n        \n        // Try to get user data if postedById exists\n        if (data.postedById) {\n          try {\n            const userDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'users', data.postedById));\n            if (userDoc.exists()) {\n              // Explicitly type the user data\n              const userData = userDoc.data() as Record\u003cstring, unknown\u003e;\n              jobData.userData = userData;\n            }\n          } catch (userErr) {\n            console.log(&#96;Could not fetch user data for ${data.postedById}:&#96;, userErr);\n          }\n        }\n        \n        return jobData;\n      }));\n      \n      setJobs(jobsData);\n      console.log('Jobs data:', jobsData);\n      setError(null);\n    } catch (err) {\n      const errorMessage = &#96;Error fetching jobs from '${collectionToCheck}': ${err instanceof Error ?         "contents": "\n\nconst EnhancedTasksHub: React.FC\u003cEnhancedTasksHubProps\u003e = ({ projectId }) =\u003e {\n  // State\n  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState\u003cCollaborativeTask[]\u003e([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState\u003cboolean\u003e(true);\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null);\n  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState\u003cViewMode\u003e('list');\n  const [selectedTask, setSelectedTask] = useState\u003cCollaborativeTask | null\u003e(null);\n  const [showTaskForm, setShowTaskForm] = useState\u003cboolean\u003e(false);\n  const [editingTask, setEditingTask] = useState\u003cCollaborativeTask | undefined\u003e(undefined);\n  const [users, setUsers] = useState\u003cRecord\u003cstring, UserData\u003e\u003e({});\n  const [filters, setFilters] = useState\u003cTaskFilters\u003e({\n    status: 'all',\n    priority: 'all',\n    category: 'all',\n    searchTerm: '',\n    assignedToMe: false\n  });\n\n  // Load users\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    const loadUsers = async () =\u003e {\n      try {\n        // Use crewProfiles collection instead of users (single source of truth)\n        const crewQuery = query(collection(db, 'crewProfiles'), where('isPublished', '==', true));\n        const snapshot = await getDocs(crewQuery);\n        const usersData: Record\u003cstring, UserData\u003e = {};\n        \n        snapshot.docs.forEach((doc: any) =\u003e {\n          const crewData = doc.data();\n          usersData[doc.id] = {\n            id: doc.id,\n            name: crewData.name || crewData.displayName || (crewData.email ? crewData.email.split('@')[0] : 'Crew Member'),\n            email: crewData.email || '',\n            avatar: crewData.profileImageUrl || crewData.photoURL\n          };\n        });\n        \n        setUsers(usersData);\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.error('Error loading users:', err);\n        setError('Failed to load users');\n      }\n    };\n\n    loadUsers();\n  }, []);",

        "contents": "export class MessagingService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  private static async getUserProfile(userId: string) {\n    try {\n      const crewDoc = await getDoc(doc(db, 'crewProfiles', userId));\n      if (crewDoc.exists()) {\n        const crewData = crewDoc.data();\n        return {\n          displayName: crewData.name || crewData.firstName || crewData.lastName || &#96;Crew Member ${userId.slice(-4)}&#96;,\n          avatarUrl: crewData.profileImageUrl || crewData.avatarUrl,\n          role: crewData.role,\n          company: crewData.company,\n          location: crewData.residences?.[0]?.city || crewData.location\n        };\n      }\n      // If no user data found, return a fallback\n      return {\n        displayName: &#96;Crew Member ${userId.slice(-4)}&#96;,\n        avatarUrl: undefined,\n        role: 'Crew Member',\n        company: undefined,\n        location: undefined\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error getting crew profile:', error);\n      return {\n        displayName: &#96;Crew Member ${userId.slice(-4)}&#96;,\n        avatarUrl: undefined,\n        role: 'Crew Member',\n        company: undefined,\n        location: undefined\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  private static updateConversationCache(userId1: string, userId2: string, lastMessage: string, timestamp: Date) {\n    const cacheKey = &#96;${userId1}_${userId2}&#96;;\n    const conversations = this.conversationCache.get(userId1) || [];\n    \n    const existingIndex = conversations.findIndex(c =\u003e c.userId === userId2);\n    if (existingIndex \u003e= 0) {\n      conversations[existingIndex].lastMessage = lastMessage;\n      conversations[existingIndex].lastMessageTime = timestamp;\n    }\n    \n    this.conversationCache.set(userId1, conversations);\n  }\n\n  /",
